description: Ministry of Tourism and Land - Appointment of Acquisition Officers - 2021
reasoning: This gazette exclusively deals with land acquisition matters, specifically the appointment and extension of Acquisition Officers for various land acquisition projects (Weras Ganga Storm Water Drainage, Road Development Projects, Southern Expressway Extension, Central Expressway Project III, and specific road projects). The content focuses on property acquisition for public works under the Land Acquisition Act, which falls squarely under the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
